content:
Project Numina is excited to announce LeanDex, an agentic semantic search tool for Lean declarations! The tool is based on @Justin Asher’s LeanExplore tool (many thanks to Justin, our work wouldn’t have been possible without you!)

LeanDex uses an LLM to elaborate search queries for more precise semantic search and ranking of results. Some example queries are below.

We also intend to support a variety of Lean projects (we currently have indexed Mathlib, the FLT project, and a few others) and we will be updating the index on a monthly basis to stay current with their development.

Please send us any feedback, comments, or feature requests you may have to our feedback form or in the discussion thread (#general > Discussion Thread for LeanDex ).
